production.note: US model year 2019 only for the coupe, from Kelley Blue Book (a database): "The 2019 McLaren 600LT is currently limited to a single trim: the Coupe 2D"; KBB's 2020 600LT page lists only the 'Spider Convertible 2D' (kbb-600lt-2020). McLaren's US media pack (mclaren-us-600lt-media-pack-2018): "Production will begin October 2018 for around 12 months; volume strictly limited". No McLaren page names the US model year. The 600LT Spider is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

transmission.note: "7 Speed SSG. Normal, Sport and Track modes" (McLaren Seamless Shift Gearbox, recorded as a DCT as in the 570S and 720S records). No manual was offered.

powerHp.note: Quote (McLaren US media pack, September 2018): "Power bhp/kW @ rpm | 592/441 @ 7,500rpm"; text: "peak power of 592bhp (600PS) at 7,500rpm". powerStandard is DIN PS because McLaren's rating is the metric 600 PS; 600 x 0.98632 = 592 hp, the figure the US document prints.

weightLb.note: Coupe, 7-speed SSG (the only transmission). Quote (McLaren US media pack): "DIN Kerb weight [fluids + 90% fuel], lbs | 2,989". DIN weight, not EU. McLaren does not say which equipment the row assumes; the row carries no footnote. The pack's headline claim, "220.5lbs lighter* than 570S Coupé DIN kerbweight", is footnoted "* with optional Super-Lightweight Carbon Fibre Racing Seats fitted". McLaren's "Lightest dry weight, lbs | 2,749" depends on options and is not used.
